extensions.name: Perchance AI
extensions.author: Doctree
extensions.description: An AI cowriter and image generator through Perchance’s free AI: improve, rewrite or continue your writing, and paint pictures for your pages. Needs the desktop or mobile app.

extensions.name: Callouts
extensions.description: Highlight a tip, a note or a warning in a coloured box. Select text and press Callout, or press it to type one.
extensions.author: Doctree

extensions.name: Word count
extensions.description: Count the words and characters in a page or the selection, with the time it takes to read.
extensions.author: Doctree
